# agyn_runner (Data Source)

Looks up a runner by name, so an environment can name the runner it places workloads on instead of carrying its UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Runners are infrastructure an environment points at, registered outside the
# config that uses them. Look one up by name rather than pasting its UUID.
data "agyn_runner" "default" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Runner name.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization to look in. Omit to search every runner the token can see.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (List of String) Capabilities the runner supports.
- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the runner.
- `labels` (Map of String) Runner labels.
